note: ark_sha256 is the digest of roots/amd-ark-genoa.der, which is now the real ARK-Genoa fetched from AMD KDS and verified self-signed, with the ASK chaining to it. The TCB floor below is still a guess: it has not been read off AMD's published Genoa TCB or off the Dallas platform, so this file is only half real. A mismatch between this digest and the compiled root is a build mistake and panics at load.
